name: Phu Quoc
provinceNote: Phú Quốc is a special zone of An Giang. Nghị quyết 1654, passed 16 June 2025, joined Dương Đông, An Thới, and the old communes into đặc khu Phú Quốc. The new commune-level governments operate from 1 July 2025. Older listings still place the island in Kiên Giang.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A tropical island in the Gulf of Thailand with long sandy beaches and sunsets over the sea. Relax on Long Beach on the west coast, swim at Sao Beach in the southeast, and eat fresh seafood at the Duong Dong night market. Suits beach lovers, couples and families.
timeNeeded: A day on the west coast, longer with Bãi Sao, the cable car, or the park.
fee: No single island ticket. Bãi Sao entrance and parking are free on the 3-day account. Other beach admission: Check on arrival. Jet skis, a water park, parasailing, and the offshore squid-boat fare: Check on arrival. Prison hours and ticket: Check on arrival. Nhà tù Phú Quốc, also trại giam Cây Dừa, An Thới, about 30 km southeast of Dương Đông. National historic relic 1996. Special national relic March 2015. History: a French camp, Cây Dừa, in 1950, about 40 ha; after July 1954 the camp stopped; in 1966 it expanded to 400 ha and 400 cells; by 1972 it had 14 zones; from 1967 to 1973 it held more than 40,000 prisoners, of whom more than 4,000 died; 42 escapes were organised. Hòn Thơm cable car from Bãi Đất Đỏ, about 31 km from Dương Đông and about 21 km from the airport. Length 7,899.9 m and the ride 15 minutes, and also about 13 km. From 1 Jan 2026 return ticket 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m and 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m, free under 1 m; runs 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. From 9 Dec 2023: adult 650,000 đồng, child 500,000 đồng, free under 1 m; hours 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. Weather and maintenance can change them. Ticket includes one same-day entry to Sun World Hon Thom, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. It does not include food, lodging, diving, walking under the sea, or the Sunset Town extras. Kiss of the Sea and Cầu Hôn show clock and price: Check on arrival. Fingernail Island boat minutes and fare: Check on arrival. Park visitor fee is collected. The number: Check on arrival. Park area: over 31,422 ha, split into 8,786 ha strict protection, 22,603 ha ecological restoration, and 33 ha administration; 31,422 ha of which 12,794 ha is forest, plus 929 plant species; 36,262 ha, of which 29,596 ha special-use forest and 6,666 ha protection forest. Coral: 89 hard, 19 soft, and 62 seaweed; nearly 100 hard, nearly 20 soft, and 62 seaweed. Whole-reserve counts: 89 hard, 19 soft, 125 reef fishes, 132 molluscs, 32 echinoderms, and 62 seaweed. Also 700 ha of coral and 87 species, and 12,000 ha of seagrass and 10 species. A half-day trek or a motorbike ride, and a 4-hour tour to Núi Chúa, 565 m. Biosphere nominated in 2006; recognition dated 27 October 2006. Reserve point latitude 9.96 and longitude 104.53 is not Dương Đông. Vinpearl Safari 09:00–16:00 every day. Under 1 m free. From 1 m to 1.4 m, and visitors over 60, 400,000 đồng. Over 1.4 m 500,000 đồng. Nearly 500 ha, phase 1 is 380 ha. Road kilometres from Dương Đông: Check on arrival. Fish sauce: about 6 million litres a year and nitrogen trên 25ºC; over 10 million litres a year; one workshop 43 percent after 15 months; 20–43 gN/lít and up to 40°N; salt 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt, aged 12 months; also 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt, about one year. Gulf of Thailand, Kiên Giang and Cà Mau waters, and the clear Andaman Sea. Pepper over 1,000 tons a year. Dinh Cậu hours and ticket: Check on arrival. Night-market stall prices: Check on arrival. A clock for the Bạch Đằng wording: Check on arrival. Gành Dầu kilometres from Dương Đông: Check on arrival. The 45 km figure is the distance to Hà Tiên, not to Gành Dầu. Superdong fares: Check on arrival. Hà Tiên crossing minutes: Check on arrival. Airport road minutes to Dương Đông: Check on arrival. Hanoi flight minutes, and minutes for flights from abroad: Check on arrival.
getThere: 1 hour by air from Ho Chi Minh City. Rạch Giá–Phú Quốc is 40 minutes by air. Superdong’s fast boat from Rạch Giá is 2 giờ 35 phút. The operator lists clocks and no crossing minutes. Hà Tiên crossing minutes, and every fare: Check on arrival. Dương Đông is 120 km from Rạch Giá and 45 km from Hà Tiên. Those are distances, not boat times.
bestMonths: November–April, and lunar month 11 to lunar month 4
seoTitle: Phu Quoc travel guide — beaches, Hon Thom cable car, night market
seoDescription: Sunset on Long Beach, the Hòn Thơm cable car from the south, and the night market in Dương Đông. Bãi Sao is the other swim, about 25 minutes from town. Pepper, pearls, and fish sauce leave with you.
intro: You are on Bãi Trường for the sunset, about 20 km of gently sloping sand from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ, the water clear enough to see the seaweed, surf and palms and low buildings along the west coast where the evening brings food, cocktails, live music, DJs, and fire shows.

The sand is called yellow, and the colour is also left unnamed. Bãi Sao is the other swim, about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông, for sunrise rather than this sunset. Its sand is called cát vàng óng, powder-white, and white, with calm water, shade trees, coconut palms, green hills, and Robinson huts. Come early on a weekday. A boat goes 15–30 km offshore for squid.

In Dương Đông, Dinh Cậu stands on the rocks at the north end of the long beach, built in 1937. It is called Dinh Cậu, Dinh Cau Temple, and Dinh Cau Pagoda. Sailors come for Cậu, a deity over the waters, and for the goddess of the sea. The lighthouse doubles as a shrine to that goddess. After the beach empties, the squid boats light the water. Dinner is the night market, under three names: the Phu Quoc Night Market on Bạch Đằng, pedestrian, with 50-plus stalls; the Dương Đông seafood market; and chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, where the streets near the temple close to traffic from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls, and also more than a hundred vendors. You choose the catch and have it grilled, with fruit and snacks.

Bún quây is the morning bowl: rice-flour noodles with fish, shrimp, squid, herbs, and onion, and a sauce you mix from chili, sugar, fish sauce, and citrus. It arrived from central Vietnam in 1955 as ground shrimp, was called bún tôm until 1996, and is served through the day and into the evening, on the street across from the Dương Đông harbour or along Long Beach. Pepper gardens are the inland morning. Pearl stalls sit in Dương Đông, at chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, at cảng An Thới, and at cảng Bãi Vòng.

Give the south its own day. The Hòn Thơm cable car leaves from Bãi Đất Đỏ. Nhà tù Phú Quốc is in An Thới. The national park is the northeast half-day, a short trek or a motorbike ride, and also a 4-hour tour to Núi Chúa, 565 m, on the Hàm Ninh range. Hàm Ninh, 20 km northeast, is the crab lunch.
gettingAround: Phu Quoc International Airport is in Duong To, with direct flights from Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and abroad. Hồ Chí Minh City–Phú Quốc is 1 hour and Rạch Giá–Phú Quốc is 40 minutes. Sun Group has operated the airport since 1 January 2026. The contact address is Duong To quarter, Phu Quoc SEZ, An Giang. On the island, motorbike rental, local taxi, minibus, and coaches are the ways around. Hàm Ninh is 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The park approach is the Dương Đông–Hàm Ninh road, then about 10 km north. The main island is 573 km², 50 km long, and widest in the north at 25 km, one of 36 islands. It is called the country’s largest island, and the old island district the largest island district in Vietnam.

Superdong’s fast boat from Rạch Giá is 2 giờ 35 phút. The operator lists clocks and no crossing minutes: Rạch Giá to Phú Quốc at 7:00, 8:10, 10:30, and 13:10, and back at 7:10, 10:10, 13:00, and 14:00, boats III, IV, V, and X, capacity 306 and 275 passengers, 26–28 hải lý/giờ. Hà Tiên to Phú Quốc leaves at 6:15, 7:30, 8:00, and 13:45, and back at 8:00, 8:20, 9:45, and 13:00, boats VI, VII, VIII, and IX, 275 passengers. Clocks can change with tide and weather. Dương Đông is 120 km from Rạch Giá and 45 km from Hà Tiên. Nam Du leaves Phú Quốc at 8:00 and returns at 14:00, boat VI. The island office is 187 Nguyễn Trung Trực, khu phố 5, đặc khu Phú Quốc. Ticket counters are listed twice: Rạch Giá at 14 Tự Do, Phường Vĩnh Thanh, and also at Số 01 Lô 4 Đường 3/2, Phường Rạch Giá, Tỉnh An Giang; Hà Tiên at 11 Trần Hầu, Phường Bình San, and also at Số 11 Đường Trần Hầu, Phường Hà Tiên, Tỉnh An Giang.

stayAreas.name: Long Beach
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on this west-coast sand if the sunset and the evening are the trip. Dinner and cocktails run along the shore. The north is the other bed: the park foothills keep high-rise rooms off Gành Dầu.

eat: Bún quây is the morning bowl, on the harbour street in Dương Đông and along Long Beach. Dinner is the catch you point at in the Dương Đông night market, or a table along Bãi Trường. Hàm Ninh’s plate is boiled crab with muối tiêu chanh. Bãi Thơm stops for a coconut, a hotpot, or a seafood platter.
interestsBody: The west-coast sand is Bãi Trường: the surf, the sunset, and the evening along the shore. Sleep here for that night. The north is the quieter bed, under the park foothills.
Bãi Sao is the southeast swim, about 25 minutes from Dương Đông, for sunrise rather than the west-coast sunset. The Hòn Thơm cable car and the night market are the other days.

blocks.heading: Dinh Cậu night market
paragraphs: After the beach empties, you choose the catch and have it grilled. The market is called the Phu Quoc Night Market on Bạch Đằng, with 50-plus stalls; the Dương Đông seafood market; and chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, streets near the temple closed from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls and more than a hundred vendors.

interestGroups.title: West-coast sand
interestGroups.summary: Bãi Trường is the shore the night is for. The sunset, the music, and the bed are on this sand.
body: Sleep on Long Beach when the sunset and the evening are why you came. The north, at Gành Dầu, is the bed the park foothills keep clear of high-rise rooms.

blocks.heading: The west-coast shore
paragraphs: Bãi Trường is gently sloping sand, about 20 km from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ, called yellow, with clear green water, and the colour is also left unnamed. Swimming, food, cocktails, live music, DJs, and fire shows sit on this west coast, and the sunset over the ocean. Sunrise is also named for this shore.
No beach ticket is given. A future eco-tourism project, Thuận An, of more than 20 ha on the north of Bãi Trường in xã Dương Tơ, is described as allowed. It is not an open hotel.

blocks.heading: Dương Đông after the swim
paragraphs: Dinh Cậu was built in 1937 for Cậu. It is also the place sailors pray to the goddess of the sea, and it is written Dinh Cau Temple and Dinh Cau Pagoda. The visit is the sunset, then the squid-boat lights.

The night market goes by three names: Phu Quoc Night Market on Bạch Đằng, with 50-plus stalls; Dương Đông seafood market; and chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, where the streets near the temple are closed to traffic from 5 pm until midnight, with 100-odd stalls, and also more than a hundred vendors. You choose the catch and have it grilled. Bún quây is the morning bowl on the harbour street and on Long Beach. Bún kèn is a noodle with a broth of dried fish, coconut milk, and a dash of curry powder.

Pepper gardens are the inland half of the same morning: aromatic and spicy, with a floral aroma and intense heat, and also pungent, over 1,000 tons a year. Pearl stalls sit in Dương Đông, at chợ đêm Dinh Cậu, at cảng An Thới, and at cảng Bãi Vòng. Fish sauce ages in the barrel houses: about 6 million litres a year and over 10 million litres a year, nitrogen 20–43 gN/lít and up to 40°N, and also trên 25ºC, salt at 2.5–3 fish to 1 salt for 12 months and also 3 tons of fish to 1 ton of salt for about a year, one workshop at 43 percent after 15 months. The catch is placed in the Gulf of Thailand and in the clear Andaman Sea.

blocks.heading: The quiet north
paragraphs: Gành Dầu is the morning when you want the crowds behind you. The park foothills keep high-rise rooms off that beach. A flat hike under old trees and a coral garden for snorkelling are named there. The 45 km figure is the distance to Hà Tiên, not to Gành Dầu.

Bãi Thơm is the northern tip, still little developed, with a view toward Cambodia. A stop there is a coconut, a hotpot, or a seafood platter. Floating restaurants sit on Rạch Vẹm Beach, the village next to Starfish Beach. Starfish beach is also placed in Rạch Vẹm fishing village, about 20 km north of Dương Đông, with the catch cooked on the spot. Starfish are in the shallows. No season is named. Bioluminescent plankton is described at Starfish Beach, on the south of Long Beach, and on the north of Dat Do Beach, at the right times of year, with no months.

Vinpearl Safari Phú Quốc is the animal park in xã Gành Dầu, not a place to sleep. It is open 09:00–16:00 every day. Under 1 m is free. From 1 m to 1.4 m, and visitors over 60, pay 400,000 đồng. Over 1.4 m pays 500,000 đồng. It covers nearly 500 ha, of which phase 1 is 380 ha.

The park is a half-day trek or a motorbike ride, and also a 4-hour tour to Núi Chúa, 565 m, on the Hàm Ninh range. Hàm Ninh, 20 km northeast, has a 300 m mountain behind the village. The village plate is ghẹ luộc with muối tiêu chanh. The park area is given as over 31,422 ha, as 31,422 ha with 12,794 ha of forest, and as 36,262 ha.

blocks.heading: An Thới and the cable
paragraphs: The prison walk is the fist monument, a cemetery, indoor and outdoor displays, a documentary, and models of the punishments. It is in An Thới, about 30 km southeast of Dương Đông, a national historic relic in 1996 and a special national relic in March 2015.

The Hòn Thơm cable car leaves from Bãi Đất Đỏ. Two return tariffs are in use: 850,000 đồng and 700,000 đồng from 1 January 2026, and 650,000 đồng and 500,000 đồng from 9 December 2023. Under 1 m is free on both. The 2026 runs are 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. The 2023 hours are 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. The length is 7,899.9 m and 15 minutes, and also about 13 km. The ticket includes one same-day entry to Sun World Hon Thom, Làng Exotica, and Aquatopia. A south-island boat to Fingernail Island is a swim and a snorkel.

cards.title: Sao Beach
cards.summary: Pale sand, calm water, and a forested hill, about 25 minutes from Dương Đông.

blocks.heading: Bãi Sao
paragraphs: Bãi Sao is cát vàng óng, fine like a carpet, with calm clear water and green shade trees, about 25 minutes from the centre of Dương Đông. It is also called powder-white, and white, with coconut palms and green hills. Come early on a weekday. The island’s sunrise is this beach. The sunset beach is Long Beach.

Robinson huts and hammocks are on the sand, and a boat goes 15–30 km offshore to fish for squid and eat the catch on the boat. The snacks here are cùi biên mai nướng and rượu sim rừng. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing are on offer. Entrance and parking are free. Western and Vietnamese food is served along the beach.

faqs.q: Where should I sleep on Phu Quoc?
faqs.a: On Long Beach if the sunset and the evening are the trip. Dinner and cocktails run along that sand. Choose Gành Dầu if you want the park foothills between the beach and high-rise rooms.

faqs.q: How do I get to Phu Quoc?
faqs.a: Hồ Chí Minh City–Phú Quốc is 1 hour by air, and Rạch Giá–Phú Quốc is 40 minutes. Superdong’s Rạch Giá boat is 2 giờ 35 phút, while the operator lists clocks and no crossing minutes. Hanoi and flights from abroad are named with no minutes. Dương Đông is 120 km from Rạch Giá and 45 km from Hà Tiên.
Bún quây, traditionally a morning bowl and now served through the day. Eat it on the street across from the Dương Đông harbour, or along Long Beach.

faqs.q: What does the Hòn Thơm cable car cost?
faqs.a: From 1 January 2026 the return is 850,000 đồng above 1.4 m and 700,000 đồng from 1 m to 1.4 m. From 9 December 2023 it is 650,000 đồng for an adult and 500,000 đồng for a child. Under 1 m is free on both. The 2026 runs are 09:30–11:30, 13:30–14:00, and 15:30–17:30. The 2023 hours are 9:00–11:30 and 13:30–17:00. Weather can change them. The length is 7,899.9 m and 15 minutes, and also about 13 km.

season.label: Calm seas, Nov–Apr
season.note: November to April is the dry season, with calm seas and clear skies, and May to October is the rainy season, with rougher seas and short heavy showers. The dry season is also counted from lunar month 11 to lunar month 4, and the rainy season from lunar month 5 to lunar month 10. Boat clocks can change with tide and weather.
